The successful candidate will keep day-to-day desktop and account support running smoothly while leading the migration of on-premises virtual servers to Microsoft Azure, deploying and managing Microsoft Intune for endpoint management, and supporting the rollout of data governance controls (retention, classification, sensitivity labels, and DLP). Exposure to computer system validation (CSV) in a GxP-regulated environment is an advantage, as the site operates under regulatory quality requirements. POSITION REPORTS TO: IT Director POSITION SUPERVISES: None ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. STRATEGIC PROJECTS (PRIMARY FOCUS) • Lead the end-to-end migration of on-premises virtual machines/servers to Microsoft Azure, including planning, sequencing, execution, and post-migration validation. • Assess current on-prem VM infrastructure and design a target Azure architecture (networking, storage, compute sizing, backup/DR, cost management). • Deploy, configure, and manage Microsoft Intune for device enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application deployment. • Support the design and implementation of data governance controls: data retention policies, data classification schemes, sensitivity labels, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules (e.g., within Microsoft Purview/Microsoft 365). • Document architecture decisions, migration runbooks, and standard operating procedures for ongoing support. • Where applicable, support computer system validation (CSV) activities for IT systems in scope of GxP requirements, working with Quality teams on protocols, documentation, and change control. 2. END-USER & DAY-TO-DAY IT SUPPORT • Provide first-line IT support to all on-site staff: account creation/deactivation, password resets, and access provisioning. • Image, configure, and deploy laptops and desktops for new hires and equipment refreshes. • Triage, log, and resolve helpdesk tickets within agreed service levels; escalate complex issues appropriately. • Support meeting room AV, printers, mobile devices, and other site IT equipment. • Maintain an accurate inventory of IT hardware and software licenses on site.
